note: The open stair towers of the blockout, read by scripts/blockout/towers.mts. 'id' is a box in floor1_plan.json (the stair's footprint). 'hall' is the side of the box the stair is entered from (S = the hall is to the south, N = to the north). 'vOff' shifts the stair east inside its box (m). 'sealed': the stair goes on up to a gated landing for a future floor 4 (a free-standing stair has none: its top opens to the roof). 'noUp': no flight up from floor 3 to that future floor. 'seed' drives the garden's plants and rocks, so the same value always gives the same garden.
